prompt.generated_prompt_string: Use the attached approved-adult face reference as the sole identity standard; preserve the adult person's face, facial structure, proportions, features, and expression accurately without celebrity or public-figure substitution. Create an ultra-detailed cinematic environmental close portrait of the subject near the open side window of a tractor completely covered in patterned carpet, parked in a vast lifeless desert. Give the subject chin-length wet black curly hair, black rectangular sunglasses, and an oversized voluminous black blazer. Their hand holds a delicate white wildflower in the foreground, slightly out of focus. Use a gently low editorial perspective that retains natural proportions, strong facial micro-detail, pores, natural skin texture, moisture on hair strands, wrinkles in the blazer, and visible carpet fibers. Set it under a heavy cloudy storm sky with soft diffused light breaking through, volumetric rays, atmospheric haze, muted desaturated colors, and restrained teal-and-orange grading. Render as ultra-sharp medium-format editorial fashion photography with shallow cinematic depth, subtle grain, and an epic dramatic mood.
